doctrines.name: router
doctrines.title: Doctrine Router
doctrines.summary: Select only the behavior guidance relevant to current work.
doctrines.content:
# Router

- Load the smallest useful doctrine set.
- Prefer explicit work, scope, and path signals.
- Explain every selected doctrine.

doctrines.name: planning
doctrines.title: Planning
doctrines.summary: Decompose work into bounded, verifiable implementation steps.
doctrines.content:
# Planning

- Clarify the objective and acceptance criteria.
- Sequence dependencies before implementation.
- Keep each task narrow enough to review and test.

doctrines.name: decisions
doctrines.title: Decisions
doctrines.summary: Record durable choices with rationale and consequences.
doctrines.content:
# Decisions

- Record choices that constrain future work.
- State reasoning and consequences explicitly.
- Supersede obsolete guidance instead of deleting history.

doctrines.name: scope
doctrines.title: Scope Control
doctrines.summary: Keep implementation inside declared work boundaries.
doctrines.content:
# Scope

- Modify only files required by active work.
- Treat excluded paths as hard boundaries.
- Stop and report when necessary work exceeds scope.

doctrines.name: questions
doctrines.title: Questions
doctrines.summary: Resolve material ambiguity without blocking routine progress.
doctrines.content:
# Questions

- Discover answers from local context first.
- State safe assumptions when risk is low.
- Ask concise questions when ambiguity could cause harmful rework.

doctrines.name: testing
doctrines.title: Testing
doctrines.summary: Verify observable behavior with focused automated evidence.
doctrines.content:
# Testing

- Test behavior and failure paths, not implementation trivia.
- Run focused tests before broader suites.
- Do not hide unrelated failures.

doctrines.name: frontend
doctrines.title: Frontend
doctrines.summary: Build accessible interfaces consistent with project patterns.
doctrines.content:
# Frontend

- Reuse established components and tokens.
- Preserve responsive and accessible behavior.
- Validate loading, empty, error, and interactive states.

doctrines.name: backend
doctrines.title: Backend
doctrines.summary: Implement reliable server behavior with explicit boundaries.
doctrines.content:
# Backend

- Validate inputs at trust boundaries.
- Keep domain logic independent from transport code.
- Make failures explicit, typed, and observable.

doctrines.name: design
doctrines.title: Design
doctrines.summary: Preserve visual hierarchy, consistency, and usability.
doctrines.content:
# Design

- Use the established design system before inventing values.
- Preserve hierarchy, rhythm, and interaction clarity.
- Treat accessibility as a design requirement.

doctrines.name: security
doctrines.title: Security
doctrines.summary: Protect trust boundaries, credentials, and sensitive data.
doctrines.content:
# Security

- Validate untrusted input and enforce authorization server-side.
- Never expose secrets in code, output, or logs.
- Prefer least privilege and fail-closed behavior.
